Processes a TWCC feedback report and returns its reference timestamp in microseconds plus whether it was out of order.
summary_step: 1. Initializes feedback count, reference time, and last feedback time on the first report.
2. Detects out-of-order reports from feedback packet count wrap semantics and logs them.
3. Converts 24-bit reference time into a monotonically cycled reference time, handling wrap in both forward and stale-report directions.
4. For in-order reports, updates the smoothed feedback interval when the new interval is not an outlier.
5. Updates latest in-order feedback state and returns the reference time in microseconds with out-of-order status.
